description: HELD-OUT retrieval eval (Phase 6): written after re-scoring was tuned on retrieval-set.json and never used to tune anything. Same format and metrics: hit@3 = an expected file in the top 3; MRR uses the rank of the first expected file within the top 10. Paths are repo-relative at each repo's last indexed commit.
